Laravel 12 project; packages: Fortify v1, Framework v12, Prompts v0, Socialite v5, Flux UI Free v2, Livewire v4, Boost v2, MCP v0, Pail v1, Pint v1, Sail v1, Pest v4, PHPUnit v12.

MUST activate the relevant skill for its domain: `fluxui-development` (Flux/UI), `livewire-development` (Livewire/reactivity), `pest-testing` (tests), `tailwindcss-development` (styling), `developing-with-fortify` (auth).

Follow code conventions; inspect sibling files, use descriptive names, reuse components. Do not create verification scripts or tinker when tests cover functionality. Stick to existing directories; don't create base folders without approval. Do not change dependencies without approval. You must only create documentation files if explicitly requested by the user. Be concise. If frontend changes aren't visible, ask them to run `npm run build`, `npm run dev`, or `composer run dev`.

Use Boost tools: `search-docs` before code changes (version-specific; use broad/simple topic queries, multiple queries, no package names); `list-artisan-commands` to check Artisan parameters; `get-absolute-url` for project URLs; `tinker` for PHP debugging/Eloquent queries; `database-query` for read-only DB access; `database-schema` before migrations/models; `browser-logs` for recent logs only.

Use curly braces for all control structures. PHP 8 constructor property promotion; no empty public constructors. Explicit return types and parameter types. Enum keys typically TitleCase. Prefer PHPDoc to comments; no code comments unless logic is exceptionally complex. Add array-shape PHPDoc when appropriate.

Every change must be programmatically tested: write/update a test and run affected tests; run the minimum needed, e.g. `php artisan test --compact --filter=testName`. Use `vendor/bin/pint --dirty --format agent` before finalizing; do not run `vendor/bin/pint --test --format agent`.

Use `php artisan make:` for files; generic classes via `php artisan make:class`. Pass `--no-interaction` to all Artisan commands and correct `--options`. Models should have useful factories/seeders; ask if user needs more, checking `php artisan make:model` options. Use factories/states in tests; follow Faker conventions. Create tests via `php artisan make:test --pest {name}`; unit tests use `--unit`. Do NOT delete tests without approval.

Prefer Eloquent relationships (typed), models over raw queries/joins, `Model::query()` over `DB::`, eager loading to prevent N+1; query builder for complex operations. APIs default to versioned Eloquent Resources unless existing conventions differ. Always use Form Requests with rules and custom messages; follow sibling rule style. Use built-in auth/authorization, named routes/`route()`, queued jobs (`ShouldQueue`) for long tasks. `env()` only in config; use `config('app.name')`. Preserve all existing column attributes when modifying migrations.

Laravel 12: middleware in `bootstrap/app.php` (`Application::configure()->withMiddleware()`), also exceptions/routes there; providers in `bootstrap/providers.php`; console config in `bootstrap/app.php` or `routes/console.php`; commands in `app/Console/Commands/` auto-register. No `app/Http/Kernel.php` or `app/Console/Kernel.php`. Eager-load limits supported (`$query->latest()->limit(10);`). Follow model cast conventions; `casts()` is preferred.

Flux: use available `<flux:*>` components; free edition excludes Pro. Livewire: state is server-side; validate/authorize actions; use Alpine for client interactions. Fortify is headless auth. Tailwind: follow existing conventions and search docs. If Vite manifest error, run `npm run build` or ask user to run `npm run dev` or `composer run dev`.
